notablePrerequisites: Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability, causing Chromatic Orrery to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, enchanting Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.
